about_the_game:
Fight, Solve, Survive — in full VR.

Dreadarion plunges you into moonlit forests, unsettling mansions, and environments shrouded in darkness, where scarce ammo, challenging puzzles, and relentless AI lurk around every corner. Every encounter is amplified by full-body VR interactions and hauntingly realistic 3D audio that makes each creak and whisper terrifyingly close.

Story

Whenever you fall asleep, an unceasing nightmare pulls you into shadowy corridors and eerie landscapes, pushing your sanity to the limit. Determined to put an end to the haunting dreams, you investigate and find out it’s a real place—only to realize the nightmare was never a warning, but an invitation. Whatever called you here awaits... and it dares you to survive the fight.

Key Features

  • Designed Exclusively for VR – Physically reload, wield melee weapons, shine your flashlight, and feel every impact.

  • Every Bullet Counts – Feel the power of pistols, shotguns, and SMGs, but limited ammo leaves no room for mistakes.

  • Hands‑On Puzzles – Rotate relics, light candles with your lighter, unlock hidden paths with real‑world gestures.

  • Soul‑Fragment Upgrades – Exchange soul crystals at flickering TVs to boost firepower, health, and speed.

  • Atmospheric Worlds – From candle‑lit corridors to fog‑drenched graveyards, each environment is carefully crafted to immerse you in dread and discovery.

  • Break Cursed Collectibles – Shatter hidden artifacts within the nightmare to gain bonus equipment and weapons.

VR Support

Valve Index, HTC Vive, Meta/Oculus headsets via SteamVR and all OpenVR devices. Room‑scale or standing play is recommended.

Face the nightmare—before it finds you.

content_descriptors.notes: This VR game features intense, first-person combat in a dark, poorly-lit, and eerie environment. Players wield melee weapons and firearms to fight enemies. Combat is accompanied by graphic blood effects and realistic corpses scattered throughout the environment. The game also contains frequent use of strong language. The overall atmosphere, combined with the gore and unsettling settings, may disturb sensitive players.

short_description: A VR action survival‑horror where you fight and solve hands‑on VR puzzles in immersive dark worlds. Conserve ammo, harvest soul fragments to upgrade your gear, and face relentless twisted creatures to escape the nightmare.
